lyrics.resolution: instrumental score; lead and backing vocal stems are effectively silent

genre.description: cinematic noir tension score with restrained trip-hop/industrial pulse, low strings, guitar, bass, synth texture, sparse brass and unresolved electronic tail

rhythm_or_pulse: Purposeful low pulse that strengthens after 15 seconds, locks into a mechanical drive around 30 seconds, opens near 78 seconds and recedes into an unresolved tail after 89 seconds.

tempo_or_non_metric_status.status: metric with cinematic rubato/texture at section edges

meter_or_groove: Slow duple/4-4 cinematic pulse with restrained trip-hop and industrial relay character; no EDM drop.
energy_curve: Low but immediate at the opening, briefly thinned at 8 seconds, steadily rising from 15 seconds, strongest and most sustained from 30-78 seconds, strategically opened at 78-89 seconds, then unresolved rather than conclusively resolved.
narrative_function: Move the film from private warning to physical departure and public systemic proof while making the transition feel prepared, intelligent and inevitable rather than chaotic.
mix_policy: Full mix is editorial authority. Stems may create smooth space for Foley and system events using ramps only; no hard score cuts. Generated video music/dialogue is discarded, while useful isolated ambience or Foley may be reviewed separately.
